name: Nisshin Seifun Group
business_summary: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the flour milling, processed foods, prepared dishes and other prepared foods, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells wheat-related products, including bran, wheat germ, rye flour, and other food-related items; home-use and commercial-use premixes, pastas, and pasta sauces marketed under the Nisshin, Ma･Ma, Ao-no-Dokutsu, De Cecco, and Welna brands; bakery fillings, cooking fillings, and mayonnaise for use in the bakery industry and other areas; and biotechnology business. It also provides health foods and functional food product materials; and delicatessen products, frozen products, as well as soba, udon, Chinese noodles, and fresh pasta to convenience stores through home delivery service. In addition, the company offers engineering services for plants producing various food items; and engages in mesh cloth business. Nisshin Seifun Group Inc. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
